name: termux-claude-code
description: Run the latest security-patched @anthropic-ai/claude-code on Termux (Android). Community-maintained wrapper. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const p=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const j=process.env.npm_package_json;const root=j?p.dirname(j):__dirname;const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[p.join(root,'install.js')],{stdio:'inherit',cwd:root});if(r.status!==0){console.error('[termux-claude-code] postinstall non-fatal failure (exit '+r.status+'). The bin/claude shim will bootstrap on first run.');console.error('  Manual debug: cd '+root+' && node install.js --debug');}process.exit(0)"
scripts.lint: node --check install.js && node --check scripts/doctor.js && node --check scripts/check-upstream.js && for f in lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && bash -n bin/claude
